description: Search the full ISO catalogue (~all deliverables) by keyword across reference, title and abstract, with optional filters. Returns reference, title, status, abstract snippet, committee and the iso.org link. Use to find standards on a topic ("supply chain security", "medical device risk").

ics.description: Filter by ICS classification code prefix, e.g. "35.030" (IT security).

query.description: Keywords matched against title + abstract + reference (full-text).

type.description: Filter by deliverable type: IS, TR, TS, PAS, Guide, …

name: search_standards
title: Search Standards
